\section{Introduction}
This file exists so you can try LaTeX rendering with \texttt{folio sample.tex}
once a \texttt{latex\_engine} is configured. It exercises sectioning, text styles
like \textbf{bold} and \textit{italic}, and mathematics.

\section{Mathematics}
Inline math such as $E = mc^2$ and $\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$ is typeset
properly here (unlike the Markdown path, which shows LaTeX as plain text).

A displayed equation:
\begin{equation}
    \int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}.
\end{equation}
